name: Progress-8
about: Progress-8 (1980-024A), a crewed vehicle (Progress), launched 1980 Mar 27. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DK).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (1980 Apr  3), held fixed
